title: Grit: Rewriting Git in Rust with agents
summary: GitButler announces Grit, an experimental project to rewrite Git core functionality in Rust, leveraging AI agents to help with the massive undertaking of reimplementing C code in a safer, more performant language while maintaining full backward compatibility.
problem_solved: Addresses Git's aging C codebase limitations in terms of performance, safety, and maintainability.
why_valuable: Rust rewrite could bring modern memory safety and performance to Git while AI agents accelerate the traditionally manual porting process.
